audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 read Singed although whys[1] and whys[2] describe Maokai's clean punish window, and row 4 reads Skill.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror (singed__maokai) settled the chart as Skill / Maokai / Maokai / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds is what ends Maokai's sustain edge at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Maokai, row 4 to Singed, as one atomic group with matched content pairs and ratings; whys[4] rewritten so the prose stops calling Level 6 even.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Maokai's 2-3 window, Singed's Level 1 proxy, Level 6, and full-build Singed. Level-6 prose corrected in the whys instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page puts Fling on Singed's W in four places ('he flings you with W', wants.foe[0], mid, late). Fling is his E; W is Mega Adhesive. The decisive combo — flung into the goo means ROOTED, not slowed — is stated nowhere.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Fling is 10s at rank 1, Mega Adhesive 17s. Insanity Potion (100s) also makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which directly cancels Sap Magic.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed and the goo-root plus real cooldowns written into tldr, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, whys[3], whys[4] and wants.foe[0].

audit.why: Itemization already calls for early anti-heal, which is the right answer to his drain-tank pattern and matches the mirror's finding.

edits.before: Don’t chase poison — W-root him, sustain up. Maokai wins the Fling cooldown windows.
edits.after: Don't chase poison — Fling (E, 10s) into Mega Adhesive roots you. Step up once it is spent.

edits.before: His flip. W-peel it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling (E) is 10s at rank 1 — step up the moment he spends it.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. W-peel it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling (E, 10s): flung into Mega Adhesive you are rooted, not just slowed — never fight on the goo. - Mega Adhesive is 17s: step off before he re-lays it. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: He starts flinging you with W and kiting on move speed — your single-target root can't pin him, so trades wash out.
edits.after: He starts flinging you (E) into Mega Adhesive and kiting on move speed — one root can't pin him, so trades wash out.

edits.before: R adds a wider root to punish a bad fling, but on its own it still doesn't lock down his speed — the duel stays even.
edits.after: R adds a wider root, but Insanity Potion (100s) makes his poison apply Grievous Wounds and shuts your Sap Magic off.

edits.before: Fling you with W into his own tower or minions, then kite away on his move-speed steroid
edits.after: Fling you (E) onto his Mega Adhesive so you are rooted, then kite off on his move-speed drift

notes: Chart now matches the singed__maokai mirror exactly.
